routingContract.unverifiedOpening: Keep original internal destination when M1 has no verified skin entry; no fabricated external drainage or pressure-to-flow change. routingContract.capacityReachedAt: Time only if mathematical cap is hit. Real900s cases can stop bleeding before reaching the cap; null means not reached.
